Game Overview

Mr. Drifter Car Chase Simulator puts players into a car experience centered on race through a vibrant cityscape, dodging relentless cops and chaotic traffic. Execute adrenaline-packed getaways using power-ups like Slow-Mo and EMP Blasts. Navigate the low-poly world in sleek escape vehicles while smashing through barriers. Endless pursuit awaits—how long can you evade capture?
